description.value: Axe & Grind is an indoor entertainment venue in the heart of downtown Victoria offering axe throwing, knife throwing, golf simulators, karaoke, and virtual reality. As a certified member of both the World Axe Throwing League and World Knife Throwing League, it brings a competitive dimension alongside casual drop-in and group bookings. Experienced staff guide newcomers through safe throwing techniques, making it a novel stop for touring cyclists seeking an off-bike adventure in the city core.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 76m; rack (20 spaces) at 88m. Total: 28 spaces.
